propositions: On Python 3.11, pytest-xdist worker crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' during test_matching_guard_is_accepted due to asyncio.wait_for consuming external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn.
Worker task loops back to queue.get() with cancelling()==1 while lifespan awaits it forever, causing pytest-timeout to kill the worker.
Replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=…) with async with asyncio.timeout(...): await asyncio.to_thread(...) restores correct cancellation semantics and fixes the hang.
The defect is Python 3.11-specific and CI-only; Python 3.12+ and local runs are unaffected.
Load-dependent teardown race in xdist worker channels reproduces the crash under artificial CPU pressure during fixture teardown.
